info.title: LogLogic Developer API
info.description: Developer-facing logging, workspace, saved-query and API-key endpoints. Set the server URL to your own backend. Administrative feature APIs are described separately in the application and backend feature documentation.

baseUrl.description: Your backend origin. Use HTTPS for hosted credentials.

post.description: Single log, array, or {logs:[...]}. At most 1,000 logs and a 5 MB HTTP body. In Kafka mode serialized records must also fit 900,000 bytes. HTTP 202 acknowledges buffering. It does not confirm MongoDB persistence. Tenant and lane are server-selected. Redaction and privacy suppression precede publish.

post.description: Explicit bearer session header and can_view_logs required; no API keys or URL tokens. Post-mortem also requires can_export_logs. All requests require an authorized workspace, enforce expiry/SSO/overrides, redact outgoing evidence and are limited to ten per user/workspace/minute. No provider diagnostics or credentials are returned. Stored IDs are always tenant-scoped. AI query output is allowlisted again during actual query/export execution.
